individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where individual samples (n=141) are the plotted markers themselves; marginal histograms show distributions. Scatter plots are exempt from requiring separate individual-point overlay.
Scatter plot of mean values per reporter with error bars; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement even though each point is an average.
Smoothed density/line curves showing distributions of periods and amplitudes; line plots are exempt from overlay requirement.
Box plot of ridge lengths; box plots already display the data distribution (and individual sample dots are additionally overlaid), so the panel is exempt/compliant.
Polar histograms show the full binned distribution of phase differences across time points, not a single averaged summary statistic requiring individual point overlay.
Polar histogram showing the distribution of subtype-averaged phase differences; histograms are not subject to the individual-points requirement.
Illustrative time-series line plot of original signal and fitted curve for a single example; line plots are exempt from the overlay requirement.
Scatter plot of fitted amplitude vs decay rate per sample with error bars representing fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - no error bars are shown; individual measurements are plotted directly with marginal histograms.
